title: Static friction gives way to kinetic friction
caption: As the push grows, static friction matches it, up to μₛmg = 98 N. Then the box starts to slide and friction drops to the kinetic value μₖmg = 78.4 N, so it takes 98 N to start the box but only 78.4 N to keep it moving steadily.
alt: Friction force against applied force: rising along the line friction equals push up to 98 newtons, then dropping to a flat 78.4 newtons.
description: Horizontal axis: the applied push. Vertical axis: the friction force.
Before sliding, friction equals the push, up to 98 N (0.5 × 20 × 9.8).
Once sliding, friction is constant at 78.4 N (0.4 × 20 × 9.8).
